## What changes for the user?

Describe the problem and resulting behavior. Link the relevant issue if there is one.

## Verification

State what you ran or checked and what it demonstrated. Record failures and limits explicitly.

## Scope and review

- [ ] The change is focused and relevant documentation is updated.
- [ ] Applicable API, data, authorization, and architecture contracts are preserved or explicitly updated.
- [ ] Regression tests cover changed behavior where appropriate.
- [ ] No credentials, customer data, runtime state, or unrelated generated files are included.
- [ ] New dependencies, if any, comply with the license and version policies.

Mention any migration, operator action, compatibility impact, or follow-up that a reviewer needs to know.
